content: Standard self-hosted worker/runner pattern (GitHub Actions runners, Claude Code self-hosted environments, CI runners generally): the worker always makes the outbound connection to the control plane over HTTPS/WSS and polls for work or holds a long-lived outbound connection; no inbound port, no public URL, and no ingress is required on the worker side. This avoids the control plane ever needing direct network/filesystem access into the worker's environment -- directly matches PixelFirm's requirement that control plane never needs filesystem access to worker repos.
